proposal.hypothesis: Prior results include five distinct valid programs: dynamic rows with chunk 1 measured 0.28208 s, cyclic static rows 0.28344 s, collapsed 2D dynamic chunks of 256 0.28388 s, guided rows 0.30548 s, and contiguous static rows 0.36279 s. These separate runs do not establish why their timings differ. This candidate tests whether dynamic row chunks of 4 reduce dispatch overhead relative to chunk 1 while retaining some load balancing; larger row batches may instead increase imbalance. The scalar recurrence, float coordinates, serial path for a one-thread team, and thread cap remain unchanged.

retained: Changed the parallel row loop from contiguous static scheduling to OpenMP dynamic scheduling with chunk size 4.
Retained the serial path, team-size cap, original float coordinate expressions, scalar recurrence, and per-pixel output writes.
